Hi Katie, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

I can't see those red lines yet. Nothing came through on my side, so I don't want to guess what they mean.

Until we know more, please power the miner down if it's showing overheating as soon as it starts. Running it hot won't help.

Could you send me:
1. Which miner this is (the Magic Miner 40T you were looking at, or another unit?)
2. A screenshot or photo of the screen showing the red lines, ideally with the temperature numbers and firmware version in view

Once I see what the screen shows, I'll take you through the next check.
I was working with somebody yesterday for a long time maybe Sarah they would know more and bring you up to speed.

Just three quick things and I'll pick it up from there:

1. Which miner is it?
2. What did you already try yesterday? A rough list is fine, so I don't make you redo it.

In the meantime, keep it powered off if it goes straight into overheating.
